cases.summary: Victim met a man presenting himself as a representative of 'Global Pathways Investment Consultancy', an international firm claiming to manage citizenship-by-investment applications. After professional-looking company documents and meetings, the victim paid an initial 'citizenship application processing fee' of AED 25,000 (2026-06-10), then — after fabricated due-diligence and 'initial security approval' documents — a second milestone payment of AED 250,000 (2026-07-14, ref TRX-2026-10482, purpose 'Citizenship by Investment – Milestone 2'). Both payments went to beneficiary MUBARAK SALEM, account 5660609, IBAN AE600340005660609. Communication then degraded into excuses about government delays before stopping entirely. Bank disclosure shows AED 180,000 withdrawn in cash and AED 60,000 transferred to a virtual-asset exchange within 72 hours of the milestone payment. KYC on file names the account holder as Mubarak Salem, with a registered contact mobile and address SHARED with the account holder of AE750340003456660 (Abdullah Mohammed).

Victim purchased a discounted gaming PC and console bundle from classifieds seller 'TechDeals UAE'. Seller contact number +971 55 302 8817. Payment of AED 8,900 (2026-08-20) by transfer to beneficiary ABDULLAH MOHAMMED, account 3456660, IBAN AE750340003456660. Goods never delivered; listing and profile deleted. Funds cashed out at ATMs the same evening.
